title: SSDi8: Accurate and Efficient 8-bit Quantization for State Space Duality
abstract: arXiv:2608.21952v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in sequence modeling have highlighted Mamba as a state space architecture offering efficient long-range dependency modeling and providing a viable alternative to Transformers. Building upon this, Mamba-2 introduces the Structured State Space Duality (SSD), which integrates recurrent and attention modes to achieve efficiency and scalability. However, this architectural expansion substantially increases memory and latency overhead, underscoring the need for efficient compression strategies tailored to SSD. In this work, we present SSDi8, the first post-training quantization framework specifically designed for SSD to maintain a persistent INT8 path. SSDi8 introduces a reformulation that decouples element-wise multiplications from matrix multiplications, enabling reuse of quantized activations across modules. Moreover, SSDi8 adaptively quantizes channel-varying activations at cost-effective points, further reducing latency. O

translated_title: SSDi8：针对状态空间对偶性的准确高效8位量化方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：近期序列建模的进展凸显了Mamba作为一种状态空间架构，能够提供高效的长距离依赖建模，并作为Transformer的可行替代方案。在此基础上，Mamba-2引入了结构化状态空间对偶性（SSD），该机制整合了循环和注意力模式，以实现效率和可扩展性。然而，这种架构扩展显著增加了内存和延迟开销，强调了针对SSD定制高效压缩策略的必要性。在本工作中，我们提出了SSDi8，这是首个专门为SSD设计的训练后量化框架，旨在维持持续的INT8路径。SSDi8引入了一种重新表述，将逐元素乘法与矩阵乘法解耦，从而允许在模块间重用量化激活。此外，SSDi8在成本效益高的点自适应地量化通道变化的激活，进一步降低延迟。
tldr: SSDi8是首个为SSD架构设计的训练后量化框架，通过解耦乘法和自适应量化激活，实现了持续的INT8路径，显著降低了内存和延迟开销。
en_tdlr: SSDi8 is the first post-training quantization framework tailored for SSD, achieving a persistent INT8 path by decoupling multiplications and adaptively quantizing activations, significantly reducing memory and latency overhead.
